name: Module 3: capsule wash
source: SPC-NAR (Leonaviciene & Mazutis, NAR 2023): capsule washes at 2000 g, 2 min, replaced here by a depth-weir trap with back-flush; CapSeq (Baronas et al., Science 2026): repeated washes between steps. Timings from operator/flow_calc.py. GENERATED by cad/generators/m3_wash.py.
description: Capsule wash on the Module 3 chip: load, 2 washes past the depth weir to waste, back-flush to resuspend, release. 7 uL/min keeps the predicted pressure on the capsule bed at 0.35 kPa (limit 3.50 kPa) and the wall shear at 0.0089 dyn/cm2 (limit 0.01). Each wash is 39.7 uL, at most the chamber's 14.7 uL. Volumes are placeholders.

steps.note: Load 10,000 capsules through the top inlet; they settle in a single layer behind the weir.
Wash 2 x 39.7 uL (the volume of three 20 uL washes, cut to fit the chamber): buffer flows past the weir to waste while the capsules stay behind it.
Back-flush from the far side to lift the capsules off the weir and resuspend them.

Flush the washed capsules out through the release outlet: 44.1 uL at 30 uL/min. The volume is about three trap volumes because a release has to SWEEP the chamber, not just fill it, and the flow is the lift flow because below it the capsule bed does not come off the weir.
